extracted.name: Panjiri
extracted.description: Multi nuts contained lots of nutrients and yum roasted wheat flour with lots of ghee. #christmas #12plates
ingredient_lines: 1 cup chopped all kind of nuts what available
1/3 cup kamar kass or butea frondosa
instruction_lines: First dry roast atta or wheat flour for 10 minutes then add ghee to make it more flavorful and aromatic.cook at low flame until looks golden and aromatic
Otherside roast in little ghee all the nuts you have available not ginger powder.roast kamarkas separate please
Add all roasted nuts and other ingredients into roasted flour but not sugar.
After roasting for 15 minutes again then add sugar in the end.mix well for 7 to 8 minutes just turn off the gas.
So easy so yumm and really good to keep body warm.merry christmas 🎄 ♥
